title: OneSearch-VL: Unified Multimodal Deep Research Agent for Image and Video
title_zh: OneSearch-VL: 统一的多模态深度研究代理，面向图像和视频

paragraphs.en: Single-image, multi-image, and video deep research require different visual operations but share a workflow of visual grounding, external retrieval, and fact composition. A key challenge is to preserve the dependencies linking localized visual anchors, entity relations, source-supported facts, and answer-producing operations. We introduce OneSearch-VL , a unified agent centered on the Visually Grounded Evidence Graph (VGEG), which encodes these dependencies as a shared task-level reference for data construction, process supervision, and operation-level evaluation. Our VGEG-based data engine constructs and verifies multi-image and video questions and filters expert trajectories. Using these data, we assemble OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K and OneSearch-VL-RL-10K for SFT and RL, respectively. We further derive the Evidence-aware Visual-Grounded Rubric reward (EVGR) from VGEG annotations to supervise evidence traceability and visual grounding during RL. For finegrained evaluation, we construct OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench , organizing questions by the research operations encoded in their VGEGs. Experiments show that OneSearch-VL-8B improves over Qwen3-VL-8B with tool access by 20.2 and 17.6 percentage points on the two new benchmarks, respectively, while also achieving substantial gains across 7 image benchmarks and VideoDR.
paragraphs.zh: 单图像、多图像和视频深度研究需要不同的视觉操作，但都共享一个工作流程：视觉锚定、外部检索和事实组合。 一个关键挑战是保留局部视觉锚点、实体关系、来源支持的事实以及答案生成操作之间的依赖关系。 我们提出了 OneSearch-VL，这是一个以“视觉锚定证据图”（VGEG）为核心的统一智能体，它将这些依赖关系编码为共享的任务级参考，用于数据构建、流程监督和操作级评估。 我们基于 VGEG 的数据引擎能够构建和验证多图像及视频问题，并筛选专家推理路径。 利用这些数据，我们分别组建了用于 SFT 和 RL 的 OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K 与 OneSearch-VL-RL-10K。 我们还从 VGEG 标注中衍生出“证据感知视觉锚定评分标准”（EVGR）奖励机制，用于在 RL 过程中监督证据可追溯性和视觉锚定。 为了进行精细评估，我们构建了 OneSearch-MI-Bench 和 OneSearch-Video-Bench，按照问题所编码的 VGEG 中的研究操作对问题进行组织。 实验表明，在启用工具访问后，OneSearch-VL-8B 在这两个新基准测试上的性能分别比 Qwen3-VL-8B 提升了 20.2 和 17.6 个百分点，同时在 7 个图像基准测试和 VideoDR 上也取得了显著进步。

paragraphs.en: Multimodal deep research enables vision-language models to move beyond direct answering by actively locating visual clues, retrieving external knowledge, and integrating evidence through multi-turn tool use ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Geng et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Recent work has extended this capability from images to videos by combining temporal localization, visual inspection, and open-web retrieval ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) . Meanwhile, unified multimodal models extend spatial-temporal understanding and reasoning across images and videos ( Li et al., 2025a ; Feng et al., 2025b ) . These advances raise a natural question: can one policy jointly learn deep research over both images and videos? Although these settings require different visual operations, they share a workflow from visual grounding to external search and fact composition, motivating unified training across multiple visual input types.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态深度研究使视觉语言模型能够超越直接回答问题，通过主动定位视觉线索、检索外部知识以及通过多轮工具使用整合证据来实现更复杂的任务（Wu 等人，2025；Geng 等人，2025a；Huang 等人，2026；Chen 等人，2026）。 近期的研究通过将时间定位、视觉检查和开放网络检索相结合，将这一能力从图像扩展到了视频（Liu 等人，2026；Gao 等人，2026；Fang 等人，2026）。 与此同时，统一的多模态模型实现了在图像和视频之间进行空间-时间理解和推理（Li 等人，2025a；Feng 等人，2025b）。 这些进展引出了一个自然的问题：一个策略是否可以同时学习对图像和视频进行深度研究？ 尽管这些设置需要不同的视觉操作，但它们共享从视觉定位到外部搜索和事实组合的工作流程，这为跨多种视觉输入类型的统一训练提供了动机。

paragraphs.en: Moving beyond prior work that primarily considers single-image or video inputs, we additionally study multi-image deep research and develop a unified framework spanning all three visual input types. Training data for this unified setting must link visual entities distributed across regions, images, or frames with relevant facts scattered across webpages. Prior work represents evidence through perception–knowledge chains, factual rubrics, and evidence graphs for task construction, supervision, and evaluation ( Jiao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . However, these structures do not jointly preserve the dependencies from localized visual anchors, through entity relations and source-supported facts, to answer composition. Video-centric pipelines similarly use extracted entities or key-frame crops mainly as retrieval or question-generation seeds ( Gao et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) , without explicitly retaining this end-to-end provenance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们超越了以往主要考虑单张图像或视频输入的研究，进一步探讨了多图像深度研究，并开发了一个涵盖所有三种视觉输入类型的统一框架。 在这种统一设置中，训练数据必须将分布在各个区域、图像或帧中的视觉实体，与散布在网页上的相关事实关联起来。 以往的研究通过感知–知识链、事实评分标准和证据图来表示证据，用于任务构建、监督与评估（Jiao et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026；Xu et al., 2026；Sun et al., 2026）。 然而，这些结构并未共同保留从局部视觉锚点出发，经由实体关系和来源支持的事实，直至答案构成的依赖关系。 以视频为核心的流程同样主要将提取的实体或关键帧裁剪作为检索或问题生成的种子（Gao et al., 2026；Fang et al., 2026），并未明确保留这种端到端的来源追溯性。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we introduce the Visually Grounded Evidence Graph (VGEG) , a unified task-level reference structure for single-image, multi-image, and video research. VGEG links localized visual anchors to real-world entities, records multi-hop relational paths and source-supported facts, and specifies the operations that compose these facts into an answer. Based on VGEG, we develop a data engine for single-image, multi-image and video research that extracts visual entities, retrieves and verifies web facts, generates compositional questions, and synthesizes expert tool-use trajectories while retaining visual locations, source provenance, and evidence dependencies. These retained dependencies support question-answer construction and verification, expert-trajectory filtering, fine-grained trajectory rewards for RL, and operation-level evaluation. With this data engine, we construct OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K and OneSearch-VL-RL-10K for SFT and RL.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这一空白，我们提出了视觉锚定证据图（VGEG），这是一种适用于单图像、多图像和视频研究的统一任务级参考结构。 VGEG将局部视觉锚点与真实世界实体关联起来，记录多跳关系路径和由来源支持的事实，并明确将这些事实组合成答案所需的操作。 基于VGEG，我们为单图像、多图像和视频研究开发了一个数据引擎，该引擎能够提取视觉实体、检索和验证网络事实、生成组合性问题，并在保留视觉位置、来源出处和证据依赖关系的同时合成专家工具使用轨迹。 这些保留的依赖关系支持问题与答案的构建与验证、专家轨迹筛选、强化学习中的精细轨迹奖励以及操作层面的评估。 借助这一数据引擎，我们构建了用于SFT和RL的OneSearch-VL-SFT-110K和OneSearch-VL-RL-10K。

paragraphs.en: Using these data, we develop OneSearch-VL , a unified agent trained on data spanning single-image, multi-image, and video inputs through SFT and RL. Existing multimodal agents supervise search through outcome rewards, query-quality signals, tool-use objectives, intermediate entity anchors, or evidence rubrics. We further introduce the Evidence-aware Visual-Grounded Rubric reward (EVGR) , constructed from our VGEG annotations to evaluate complete trajectories along two complementary dimensions: evidence traceability , which verifies whether the required facts are supported by tool observations, and visual grounding , which verifies whether the relevant objects, regions, or frames are correctly identified and used in the solution.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些数据，我们开发出了 OneSearch-VL——一个通过 SFT 和 RL 训练的统一智能体，其训练数据涵盖了单图像、多图像和视频输入。 现有的多模态智能体通过结果奖励、查询质量信号、工具使用目标、中间实体锚点或证据评分标准来监督搜索过程。 我们进一步引入了“证据感知视觉锚定评分标准”奖励（EVGR），该奖励基于我们的 VGEG 标注构建，用于从两个互补的维度评估完整的推理路径：证据可追溯性（验证所需事实是否得到工具观察结果的支持）和视觉锚定（验证相关物体、区域或帧是否在解决方案中被正确识别和使用）。

paragraphs.en: For fine-grained evaluation, we also introduce OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench . Our benchmarks instead organize questions according to the research operations represented in their corresponding VGEGs, which capture the entity-relation paths and fact-composition dependencies required to derive the answer. This organization emphasizes how an agent retrieves and composes evidence rather than what the visual input contains.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate OneSearch-VL on established and two new benchmarks. OneSearch-VL-8B outperforms Qwen3-VL-8B by 20.2, 17.6, and 27.0 points on OneSearch-MI-Bench, OneSearch-Video-Bench, and VideoDR, respectively. Joint SFT on all three visual input types achieves a six-benchmark average of 55.8, versus 51.7-55.1 for single-type training. EVGR further raises the average from 57.3 to 61.1 over answer and query rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在现有基准和两个新基准上对 OneSearch-VL 进行了评估。 在 OneSearch-MI-Bench、OneSearch-Video-Bench 和 VideoDR 上，OneSearch-VL-8B 分别比 Qwen3-VL-8B 高出 20.2、17.6 和 27.0 分。 对全部三种视觉输入类型进行联合 SFT 后，六个基准的平均分为 55.8，而单一类型训练的平均分为 51.7-55.1。 EVGR 进一步将答案和查询奖励的平均分从 57.3 提升至 61.1。

sents.en: OneSearch-VL-8B outperforms Qwen3-VL-8B by 20.2, 17.6, and 27.0 points on OneSearch-MI-Bench, OneSearch-Video-Bench, and VideoDR, respectively.
sents.zh: 在 OneSearch-MI-Bench、OneSearch-Video-Bench 和 VideoDR 上，OneSearch-VL-8B 分别比 Qwen3-VL-8B 高出 20.2、17.6 和 27.0 分。

We verify the question and answer against the selected evidence and rewrite explicit entity mentions into visually grounded references. We then instantiate each task for its target visual input type. For a multi-image task, the deduplicated key frames containing the required anchors form an unordered image collection, and frame-level references are remapped to image indices. For a video task, the original video is retained together with its event, timestamp, frame, and region bindings. Additional filters remove answer leakage, ambiguous references, visually irrelevant questions, and instances that can be confidently answered without the visual input. See Appendix A.4 for details. For single-image task, we reuse existing data ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and convert its Wikipedia entity-sampling paths and associated visual anchors into VGEGs.

paragraphs.en: Existing multimodal search and video deep-research benchmarks primarily report aggregate answer accuracy, often with additional breakdowns by visual content or data source ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . These summaries measure overall performance but do not isolate failures in entity lookup, relation tracing, conditional filtering, or fact composition. We therefore construct OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench and organize their examples by the principal research operation required to answer each question. Both benchmarks use the same operation taxonomy, enabling a consistent analysis across multi-image and video inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的多模态搜索和视频深度研究基准测试主要报告综合答案准确率，通常会额外按视觉内容或数据源进行细分（Liu et al., 2026；Gao et al., 2026）。 这些总结衡量了整体性能，但未能单独识别出实体查找、关系追踪、条件过滤或事实组合方面的失败情况。 因此，我们构建了 OneSearch-MI-Bench 和 OneSearch-Video-Bench，并按照回答每个问题所需的主要研究操作对示例进行了分类组织。 这两个基准测试均使用相同的操作分类体系，从而能够跨多图像和视频输入进行一致的分析。

paragraphs.en: Terminal correctness does not directly measure whether a rollout obtains and uses the evidence required by the question. We therefore introduce the Evidence-aware Visual-Grounded Rubric reward (EVGR). As illustrated in Figure 3 , EVGR aligns each executed trajectory with an item-specific structured rubric derived from the data engine. The rubric records the answer core, required claim facts, supporting sources and snippets, and applicable frame or region annotations. Two separate judge calls evaluate complementary dimensions. Evidence Traceability ( r trace r_{\mathrm{trace}} ) measures whether tool observations establish the answer-core entities and required fact hops, and whether the reasoning follows those observations without unsupported substitutions. Visual Grounding ( r ground r_{\mathrm{ground}} ) measures whether the correct visible entities, regions, or video frames are identified and used to drive subsequent evidence retrieval. For single- and multi-image inputs, the source images are already visible to the agent policy and no additional visual tool call is required; for video, the selected frames should cover the relevant moments and provide the visual identity used by later searches. The two dimensions are combined into the trajectory-level process reward R EVGR R_{\mathrm{EVGR}} . Their scoring and combination coefficients are specified in the experimental setup.

paragraphs.en: For single-image evaluation, we follow OpenSearch-VL ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and use seven knowledge-intensive benchmarks: SimpleVQA ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , VDR ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) , MMSearch ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , LiveVQA ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , BrowseComp-VL ( Geng et al., 2025b ) , FVQA ( Wang et al., 2017 ) , and InfoSeek ( Chen et al., 2023 ) . For multi-image and video evaluation, we use our OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench, together with VideoDR ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . On the two OneSearch benchmarks, we additionally report performance by the six principal research operations defined in Section 4 . Following OpenSearch-VL, we use GPT-4o ( OpenAI Team, 2024 ) to compare each final response with the reference answer and return a binary correctness decision.

These categories require the model to filter, connect, or compute over facts associated with multiple visual anchors, matching the compositional operations covered by our data engine.

paragraphs.en: Using both Trace and Ground yields the best average of 61.1, improving by 3.8 points over answer-plus-query rewards and by 2.1 and 1.8 points over the two single-dimension variants. paragraphs.en: Active search enables language models to supplement parametric knowledge with external evidence acquired through multi-turn interaction ( Jin et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: Video deep research additionally requires agents to locate relevant moments, identify objects across frames, and connect them to external knowledge. paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning has improved image question answering and detection ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025 ) , image segmentation ( You and Wu, 2025 ) , video question answering ( Feng et al., 2025a ) , and temporal or spatio-temporal video understanding ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ) , with many methods designed for specific tasks. LLaVA-ST jointly addresses fine-grained spatial, temporal, and spatio-temporal understanding ( Li et al., 2025a ) . OneThinker jointly learns question answering, captioning, grounding, tracking, and segmentation across images and videos, demonstrating the potential of training across tasks and visual inputs ( Feng et al., 2025b ) . Our work focuses on unification at the level of deep research: a single policy combines input-specific visual operations with external retrieval and fact composition across single images, image collections, and videos.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习已提升了图像问答与检测（Huang 等，2025；Shen 等，2025）、图像分割（You 和 Wu，2025）、视频问答（Feng 等，2025a），以及时间或时空视频理解（Wang 等，2025；Li 等，2025b）的能力，其中许多方法是为特定任务而设计的。 LLaVA-ST 联合处理了精细的空间、时间和时空理解（Li 等，2025a）。 OneThinker 在图像和视频之间联合学习问答、描述生成、定位、跟踪和分割，展示了跨任务和视觉输入进行训练的可能性（Feng 等，2025b）。 我们的工作聚焦于深度研究层面的统一：单一策略将输入特定的视觉操作与外部检索及事实组合相结合，涵盖单张图像、图像集和视频。

paragraphs.en: Beyond answer correctness, research agents receive supervision through query-quality and tool-use rewards ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . Other approaches use intermediate entity anchors and citation-supported factual requirements as references for credit assignment ( Jiao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , while process-oriented objectives evaluate search decisions or complete rollouts ( Yan et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . These studies establish the value of structured evidence for agent supervision. We use VGEG to preserve visual provenance and answer-composition dependencies in a shared task-level reference, connecting task construction and verification with trajectory supervision. EVGR derives evidence-traceability and visual-grounding criteria from this reference to evaluate complete research trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 除了答案的正确性之外，研究智能体还通过查询质量和工具使用奖励接受监督（Chen 等人，2026；Gao 等人，2026）。 其他方法则利用中间实体锚点和有引文支持的事实性要求作为信用分配的参考（Jiao 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2026），而面向流程的目标则评估搜索决策或完整的执行过程（Yan 等人，2026；Wang 等人，2026）。 这些研究确立了结构化证据在智能体监督中的价值。 我们使用 VGEG 在共享任务级参考中保留视觉来源和答案构成的依赖关系，从而将任务构建与验证同轨迹监督连接起来。 EVGR 从该参考中推导出证据可追溯性和视觉接地标准，以评估完整的研究轨迹。

paragraphs.en: We introduced OneSearch-VL, a unified agent for deep research over single-image, multi-image, and videos. VGEG links visual anchors, source-supported facts, and answer-producing operations, enabling verified task construction, expert-trajectory filtering, and process-level reward design. Building on this structure, EVGR evaluates both evidence traceability and visual grounding. Across seven established single-image benchmarks and two operation-oriented benchmarks, OneSearch-VL consistently improves over the evaluated open-source baselines; the ablations further demonstrate complementary supervision across visual input types and the benefit of EVGR.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了 OneSearch-VL，这是一个用于单图像、多图像和视频深度研究的统一智能体。 VGEG 将视觉锚点、由源数据支持的事实以及生成答案的操作连接起来，从而实现经过验证的任务构建、专家轨迹筛选和流程级奖励设计。 基于这一结构，EVGR 评估了证据可追溯性和视觉基础两个方面。 在七个成熟的单图像基准测试和两个以操作为导向的基准测试中，OneSearch-VL 持续优于所评估的开源基线模型；消融研究进一步证明了不同视觉输入类型之间互补的监督机制以及 EVGR 的优势。

paragraphs.en: OneSearch-VL depends on external search tools such as TextSearch and ImageSearch (Table 1 ) and changing webpages, which can affect evidence availability and exact reproducibility. Future work should preserve retrieval snapshots and evaluate robustness to tool failures. Automated VGEG construction and model-based rewards may also introduce annotation errors or judging biases. Human calibration and open multimodal process judges could improve the reliability of trajectory-level assessment. Multi-turn interaction incurs additional inference and tool costs, motivating adaptive budgets and cost-aware training.

paragraphs.en: We use GPT-4.1 ( OpenAI, 2025a ) to assess whether each video potentially contains multiple scenes, searchable entities, specific events, visual information, and available web evidence. We combine its assessment with the rule-based metadata score and retain 72k candidates. This step operates on textual metadata; visual inspection occurs in the subsequent anchor-discovery stage.

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 (b) contains five blocks: Video Clip & Caption, Key-Frame Selection & Caption, Cross-Clip Frame Deduplication, Event Aggregation & Caption, and Event Key-Frame Selection & Key Object Grounding. Their outputs form the Video Dense Caption Tree.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 (b) 包含五个模块：视频片段与描述、关键帧选择与描述、跨片段帧去重、事件聚合与描述，以及事件关键帧选择与关键对象定位。 它们的输出构成了视频密集描述树。

paragraphs.en: We uniformly sample each video at a target rate of 2 FPS, and divide the frames into temporally ordered local clips of ten frames. A final group with fewer than five frames is merged into its predecessor. We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to describe the scenes, actions, and identifiable entities in each clip.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以 2 FPS 的目标帧率对每个视频进行均匀采样，并将各帧划分为按时间顺序排列的十帧本地片段。 若最终某个片段少于五帧，则将其与前一个片段合并。 我们使用 Seed 2.0 Pro（ByteDance Seed，2026）来描述每个片段中的场景、动作和可识别实体。

sents.en: We uniformly sample each video at a target rate of 2 FPS, and divide the frames into temporally ordered local clips of ten frames.
sents.zh: 我们以 2 FPS 的目标帧率对每个视频进行均匀采样，并将各帧划分为按时间顺序排列的十帧本地片段。

sents.zh: 若最终某个片段少于五帧，则将其与前一个片段合并。

sents.en: We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to describe the scenes, actions, and identifiable entities in each clip.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Seed 2.0 Pro（ByteDance Seed，2026）来描述每个片段中的场景、动作和可识别实体。

paragraphs.en: For each clip, we use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to select representative key frames and generate key-moment descriptions and candidate entity cues, while retaining the frame indices and timestamps.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个剪辑片段，我们使用 Seed 2.0 Pro（字节跳动 Seed，2026）来选择具有代表性的关键帧，并生成关键时刻描述和候选实体提示，同时保留帧索引和时间戳。

paragraphs.en: We use Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B ( Li et al., 2026 ) to encode each candidate frame and its description as normalized image and text embeddings. Candidates are compared in temporal order against the most recently retained frame. A candidate is removed when image similarity is at least 0.9 or text similarity is at least 0.8. The similarity thresholds are stored with the deduplication output.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B（Li et al., 2026）对每个候选帧及其描述进行编码，生成归一化的图像和文本嵌入。 候选项按照时间顺序与最近保留的帧进行比较。 当图像相似度至少为 0.9 或文本相似度至少为 0.8 时，该候选项将被移除。 相似度阈值会与去重输出一起保存。

sents.en: We use Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B ( Li et al., 2026 ) to encode each candidate frame and its description as normalized image and text embeddings.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B（Li et al., 2026）对每个候选帧及其描述进行编码，生成归一化的图像和文本嵌入。

sents.en: Candidates are compared in temporal order against the most recently retained frame.
sents.zh: 候选项按照时间顺序与最近保留的帧进行比较。

sents.en: A candidate is removed when image similarity is at least 0.9 or text similarity is at least 0.8.
sents.zh: 当图像相似度至少为 0.9 或文本相似度至少为 0.8 时，该候选项将被移除。

paragraphs.en: We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to merge temporally adjacent, semantically related clips into coherent events based on the clip descriptions and deduplicated key frames. Each event records a title, temporal range, description, covered clip range, and searchable entity cues, forming the temporal hierarchy from the video to its events.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Seed 2.0 Pro（字节跳动 Seed，2026）基于片段描述和去重后的关键帧，将时间上相邻且语义相关的片段合并为连贯的事件。 每个事件都记录标题、时间范围、描述、所覆盖的片段范围以及可搜索的实体提示，从而构建从视频到其事件的时序层级结构。

sents.en: We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to merge temporally adjacent, semantically related clips into coherent events based on the clip descriptions and deduplicated key frames.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Seed 2.0 Pro（字节跳动 Seed，2026）基于片段描述和去重后的关键帧，将时间上相邻且语义相关的片段合并为连贯的事件。

paragraphs.en: For each event, we select representative key frames and use Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) to localize visible, searchable objects. Each object records a name or description, a type, a normalized bounding box, and its relation to the event. Bounding boxes use coordinates in [ 0 , 1000 ] 4 [0,1000]^{4} .
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个事件，我们选择具有代表性的关键帧，并使用 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct（Bai 等人，2025）来定位可见且可搜索的对象。 每个对象记录一个名称或描述、一个类型、一个归一化的边界框，以及它与事件的关系。 边界框使用 [0, 1000] 范围内的坐标 [0,1000]^{4}。

sents.zh: 对于每个事件，我们选择具有代表性的关键帧，并使用 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct（Bai 等人，2025）来定位可见且可搜索的对象。

sents.en: Each object records a name or description, a type, a normalized bounding box, and its relation to the event.
sents.zh: 每个对象记录一个名称或描述、一个类型、一个归一化的边界框，以及它与事件的关系。

paragraphs.zh: 由此产生的层级结构保留了时间和空间参照：

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 (c) routes localized Objects through image search or OCR followed by text search, assembles a Candidate Entity Pool, expands related entities and attributes through the Expand Entity Pipeline, and produces a Web Entity Graph.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1(c) 通过图像搜索或 OCR 结合文本搜索对局部化的对象进行路由，构建候选实体池，通过“扩展实体流程”扩展相关实体和属性，并生成一个网络实体图。

paragraphs.en: Object grouping and representative-view selection use deterministic matching. Objects with matching types and similar entity or name cues are grouped across frames; the largest available bounding box is selected as the representative view, with alternate views retained from other frames. Crops with a short side below 256 pixels are enlarged to 256 pixels. We use GPT-4.1 ( OpenAI, 2025a ) to route each object to reverse image search, OCR followed by text search, or omission based on its crop, name, type, candidate entity cues, and event relation. For the OCR route, we also use the model to read visible text and propose a candidate entity; the image-search route uses an external reverse-image-search service to retrieve candidate entities and webpages.
paragraphs.zh: 对象分组和代表视图选择使用确定性匹配。 类型匹配且实体或名称线索相似的对象会在不同帧中分组；选择最大的可用边界框作为代表视图，并保留来自其他帧的替代视图。 短边小于 256 像素的裁剪图像会被放大至 256 像素。 我们使用 GPT-4.1（OpenAI, 2025a）根据每个对象的裁剪、名称、类型、候选实体线索和事件关系，将其路由至反向图像搜索、OCR 加文本搜索，或跳过处理。 对于 OCR 路线，我们还使用该模型读取可见文本并提出候选实体；图像搜索路线则使用外部反向图像搜索服务来获取候选实体和网页。

sents.en: Object grouping and representative-view selection use deterministic matching.
sents.zh: 对象分组和代表视图选择使用确定性匹配。

sents.en: Objects with matching types and similar entity or name cues are grouped across frames; the largest available bounding box is selected as the representative view, with alternate views retained from other frames.
sents.zh: 类型匹配且实体或名称线索相似的对象会在不同帧中分组；选择最大的可用边界框作为代表视图，并保留来自其他帧的替代视图。

sents.en: Crops with a short side below 256 pixels are enlarged to 256 pixels.
sents.zh: 短边小于 256 像素的裁剪图像会被放大至 256 像素。

sents.en: We use GPT-4.1 ( OpenAI, 2025a ) to route each object to reverse image search, OCR followed by text search, or omission based on its crop, name, type, candidate entity cues, and event relation.
sents.zh: 我们使用 GPT-4.1（OpenAI, 2025a）根据每个对象的裁剪、名称、类型、候选实体线索和事件关系，将其路由至反向图像搜索、OCR 加文本搜索，或跳过处理。

sents.en: For the OCR route, we also use the model to read visible text and propose a candidate entity; the image-search route uses an external reverse-image-search service to retrieve candidate entities and webpages.
sents.zh: 对于 OCR 路线，我们还使用该模型读取可见文本并提出候选实体；图像搜索路线则使用外部反向图像搜索服务来获取候选实体和网页。

paragraphs.en: Because reverse image search is sensitive to viewpoint and cropping, we construct a retrieval pool for each object grouped across frames, containing its representative crop and alternate views from other sampled frames. If one crop yields no usable candidates, we retry the search with another view from the same object pool. We first use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to select visually grounded anchors with research potential from the event context and initial retrieval results. We then use the model to combine the object crop, local visual description, and image-search or OCR evidence to propose an entity identity, assess whether the retrieved entity matches the visual object, and formulate entity-specific text queries. We use Qwen3-32B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) to read the retrieved pages, produce query-focused summaries, and verify consistency between the page evidence and the candidate identity; search snippets are used when the page body is unavailable. Duplicate pages and explicitly mismatched identities are removed. The remaining identities, source objects, and webpage evidence form the candidate entity pool.
paragraphs.zh: 由于反向图像搜索对视角和裁剪非常敏感，我们为每个跨帧分组的对象构建一个检索池，其中包含其代表性裁剪区域以及从其他采样帧中获取的替代视角。 如果某个裁剪区域未能产生可用的候选项，我们将使用同一对象池中的另一个视角重新执行搜索。 我们首先使用 Seed 2.0 Pro（ByteDance Seed，2026）从事件上下文和初步检索结果中筛选出具有研究潜力的、视觉基础明确的锚点。 接着，我们使用该模型结合对象裁剪区域、局部视觉描述以及图像搜索或 OCR 证据，提出实体身份识别，评估检索到的实体是否与视觉对象匹配，并生成针对该实体的特定文本查询。 我们使用 Qwen3-32B（Yang et al.，2025）读取检索到的页面，生成以查询为核心的摘要，并验证页面证据与候选身份之间的一致性；若页面正文不可用，则使用搜索片段替代。 重复页面和明显不匹配的身份信息将被移除。 剩余的身份、源对象和网页证据共同构成候选实体池。

paragraphs.en: We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to extract source-supported relations from the verified page summaries. Each fact records its head entity, relation, tail entity or attribute value, supporting URL, and evidence quotation:
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Seed 2.0 Pro（字节跳动 Seed，2026）从经过验证的页面摘要中提取有来源支持的关系。 每个事实都记录了其头实体、关系、尾实体或属性值、支持性 URL 以及证据引文：

sents.en: We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to extract source-supported relations from the verified page summaries.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Seed 2.0 Pro（字节跳动 Seed，2026）从经过验证的页面摘要中提取有来源支持的关系。

sents.en: Each fact records its head entity, relation, tail entity or attribute value, supporting URL, and evidence quotation:
sents.zh: 每个事实都记录了其头实体、关系、尾实体或属性值、支持性 URL 以及证据引文：

paragraphs.en: Here, p p is the source URL and ξ \xi is the retained supporting text. A deterministic parser checks required fields and matches normalized quotations against the supplied source material; a matched quotation must contain at least six normalized characters. Numeric facts can additionally retain units and value types. For entity-valued tails, we use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) to decide whether to continue based on entity specificity, relation confidence, task relevance, and evidence-expansion potential and to propose a follow-up query; we then use Qwen3-32B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) to summarize and verify the retrieved expansion pages. For each expandable entity, the pipeline retains one query, retrieves five results, deduplicates pages by host, and reads the selected pages. Each parent selects high-confidence successors with scores of at least 0.5, and expansion stops when no suitable successor remains.
paragraphs.zh: 此处，p p 是源 URL，而 ξ \xi 是保留的辅助文本。 确定性解析器会检查必填字段，并将规范化引文与提供的源材料进行匹配；匹配的引文必须包含至少六个规范化字符。 数值事实还可以保留单位和值类型。 对于实体值尾部，我们使用 Seed 2.0 Pro（ByteDance Seed，2026）来决定是否根据实体的具体性、关系的置信度、任务的相关性以及证据扩展的潜力继续操作，并提出后续查询；然后我们使用 Qwen3-32B（Yang et al.，2025）来总结并验证检索到的扩展页面。 对于每个可扩展的实体，该流程保留一个查询，检索五个结果，按主机去重页面，并读取选定的页面。 每个父节点会选择置信度得分至少为 0.5 的高置信后续节点，当没有合适的后续节点时，扩展过程即停止。

Frame references are checked against the available entity-to-frame mappings, and the facts required to derive the answer must be supported by the candidate graph.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器首先使用确定性规则，无需额外模型调用，将证据路径和任务结构与候选图进行比对。 关系链问题需要检查连续事实之间的连贯性。 多锚点问题要求存在不同的引用对象以及相应的支持性事实。 比较问题需使用共同的语义属性；算术问题需使用含义兼容的数值操作数；知识条件计数则需将计数的实体与支撑该条件的关联事实相联系。 框架引用需与可用的实体到框架映射进行比对，且推导出答案所需的事实必须由候选图提供支持。

paragraphs.en: We use Seed 2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed, 2026 ) as the expert model to solve each verified task in the real tool environment. The expert receives the visual input, question, and tool definitions, while the reference answer is withheld for subsequent evaluation. At each turn, the model produces reasoning followed by a tool call or a final response. The environment executes the tool and appends its observation, including returned visual resources, to the interaction history, producing an interleaved reasoning–action–observation trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Seed 2.0 Pro（字节跳动 Seed，2026）作为专家模型，在真实工具环境中解决每个经过验证的任务。 专家接收视觉输入、问题和工具定义，而参考答案则被保留用于后续评估。 在每个回合中，模型会先输出推理过程，然后发出工具调用或给出最终响应。 环境执行工具操作，并将观察结果（包括返回的视觉资源）追加到交互历史中，从而形成推理–行动–观察交织的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: This appendix details the construction protocols for OneSearch-MI-Bench and OneSearch-Video-Bench, including visual-input construction, VGEG-based operation assignment, difficulty and visual-domain annotation, and human review.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录详细说明了 OneSearch-MI-Bench 和 OneSearch-Video-Bench 的构建协议，包括视觉输入构建、基于 VGEG 的操作分配、难度与视觉领域标注，以及人工审核。

paragraphs.en: For OneSearch-MI-Bench, deduplicated evidence frames from the same source video form an unordered image collection. Questions are rewritten to refer to the images and visible objects, while image indices preserve the bindings to their visual anchors. References to video playback, frame numbers, and unnecessary temporal order are removed. Each retained item requires evidence from at least two images, preventing reduction to a single-image question.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 OneSearch-MI-Bench，来自同一源视频的已去重证据帧构成一个无序的图像集合。 问题被改写为指向这些图像和可见物体，同时图像索引保留了与视觉锚点的绑定关系。 对视频播放、帧编号以及不必要的时序顺序的引用均被移除。 每个保留的项目都需要至少两张图像的证据，从而避免问题被简化为单图像问题。

For example, two anchors may each initiate multi-hop retrieval, but a question is labeled as multi-anchor comparison when its final answer compares the retrieved attributes. They verify that each visual reference identifies the intended object, each required fact is source-supported, the reference answer follows from the VGEG dependencies, and the principal operation matches the final answer-producing step. The reviewed record retains the confirmed visual-anchor bindings, supporting facts, reference answer, and operation annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 自动筛选后，人类标注员会共同检查视觉输入、问题、参考答案、任务级别的 VGEG 以及支持性网页。 他们需验证每个视觉参考是否准确标识了目标对象，每个必要事实是否有来源支持，参考答案是否遵循 VGEG 的依赖关系，以及主要操作是否与生成最终答案的步骤一致。 经过审核的记录将保留已确认的视觉锚点绑定、支持性事实、参考答案和操作标注。

paragraphs.en: A final quality review further checks question clarity, the presence and distinguishability of the referenced visual objects, and consistency across the annotations. paragraphs.en: This appendix specifies the execution semantics of the tools in Table 1 , including visual-resource registration, tool inputs and outputs, and the common interaction records used for expert synthesis, reinforcement learning, and inference.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录规定了表 1 中工具的执行语义，包括视觉资源注册、工具输入与输出，以及专家合成、强化学习和推理中使用的通用交互记录。

paragraphs.en: At the beginning of an episode, the environment registers the visual input in an episode-level resource table. A single image and each member of an image collection receive separate image handles, while a video handle refers to the sampled frame grid visible to the policy. Crops, enhanced images, extracted frames, and selected clips are registered as new image or clip handles and can be reused by later calls. This enables compositions such as selecting a video frame, cropping a local region, and then applying OCR or image search.
paragraphs.zh: 在回合开始时，环境会将视觉输入记录到回合级资源表中。 单张图像和图像集合中的每个成员都会获得独立的多媒体句柄，而视频句柄则指策略可见的采样帧网格。 裁剪区域、增强后的图像、提取的帧以及选定的片段会被注册为新的图像或片段句柄，并可供后续调用重复使用。 这使得诸如选择视频帧、裁剪局部区域，然后应用 OCR 或图像搜索等操作成为可能。

paragraphs.en: We implement spatial cropping with PIL. Given an image handle and a normalized box ( x 1 , y 1 , x 2 , y 2 ) ∈ [ 0 , 1000 ] 4 (x_{1},y_{1},x_{2},y_{2})\in[0,1000]^{4} , the executor maps the box to pixel coordinates, extracts the region, and registers it as a new image resource. paragraphs.en: We implement OCR with PaddleOCR. paragraphs.en: We implement perspective correction with OpenCV. The rectified fronto-parallel view is registered as a new image resource.

paragraphs.en: Visual inputs, user questions, tool definitions, and tool observations serve as conditioning context, while the supervised targets comprise assistant reasoning, tool commands, and final responses. The loss mask is therefore one for policy-generated tokens and zero for environment observations and other conditioning tokens. This prevents the model from being trained to reproduce tool outputs while preserving its ability to condition subsequent actions on executed observations.

paragraphs.en: The judge checks whether tool observations establish the answer-core entities and fact hops required by the rubric and whether subsequent reasoning follows those observations. For videos, the selected frames are compared with the reference moments, and the visual identities obtained from those frames must guide the subsequent evidence search.

paragraphs.en: Following the main-text setup, we use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Given a group of trajectories sampled for the same question, GRPO derives relative advantages from their within-group rewards and updates the policy with a clipped objective. The policy loss is applied only to model-generated reasoning, tool-command, and final-response tokens, while tool observations remain conditioning context. For trajectories truncated by a terminal tool error, only the valid interaction prefix preceding the failure participates in optimization ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 遵循正文中的设定，我们使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）。 对于为同一问题采样的一组轨迹，GRPO 基于其组内奖励计算相对优势，并通过截断目标函数更新策略。 策略损失仅应用于模型生成的推理、工具命令和最终响应标记，而工具观察结果则保留为条件上下文。 对于因终端工具错误而被截断的轨迹，只有失败前的有效交互前缀会参与优化（Chen 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 asks for the difference between two manufacturers’ founding years. The agent crops the rear of a blue sports car and identifies a Ford Mustang through ImageSearch , then crops a brake-caliper logo in another image to identify Brembo. TextSearch returns 1903 for Ford and 1961 for Brembo, and the final response computes 1961 − 1903 = 58 1961-1903=58 . The two visual anchors lead to distinct entities and numerical facts, which a subtraction operation combines into the answer, illustrating the dependencies captured by VGEG.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 要求计算两家制造商成立年份之间的差值。 智能体裁剪了一辆蓝色跑车车尾部分，并通过图像搜索识别出这是一辆福特野马，随后在另一张图片中裁剪了制动卡钳上的标志，从而识别出布雷博。 文本搜索返回福特的成立年份为 1903 年，布雷博的成立年份为 1961 年，最终计算得出 1961 − 1903 = 58。 这两个视觉锚点分别指向不同的实体和数值事实，通过减法运算将它们结合成答案，从而展示了 VGEG 所捕捉到的依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 asks how many car models in three separate images are produced by a company owned by Volkswagen.
